The issuer exhibits strong profitability and interest coverage with an EBIT margin of 15.7% and a Return on Assets (ROA) of 9.2%, alongside a solid balance sheet reflected in an Equity-to-Assets ratio of 42.3% and a healthy current ratio of 1.87. However, the moderate overall scale and absolute debt burden relative to its equity base position the company in the high investment-grade tier rather than the highest AAA/AA levels.

DECISION: A
